hooks.command: project_root="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)}"; cd "$project_root" || exit 0; [ -f uv.lock ] || exit 0; [ -f noxfile.py ] || exit 0; grep -Eq '^def[[:space:]]+agent\(' noxfile.py || exit 0; output="$(uv run --locked nox -s agent 2>&1)" || { printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2; exit 2; }
